## Scope checklist

- [ ] The change preserves the two required user choices.
- [ ] Provider arguments remain transparent and provider-neutral.
- [ ] The original PDF is not modified, overwritten, or deleted.
- [ ] Unselected output modes are not delivered.
- [ ] Raster-figure failures retain the original and produce a warning.
- [ ] No private PDFs, credentials, temporary sessions, generated mirrors, or machine-specific paths are included.
